title: AI-Augmented Variant Interpretation in Ovarian Cancer
text:
Learning objectives

Audit an NGS call beyond raw VAF
Use IGV to inspect depth, base quality and mapping evidence
Interpret low-VAF calls critically
Integrate purity, copy number and LOH
Separate BRCA/HRD biology from germline/somatic origin
Audit LLM output with source-grounded constraints

title: AI-Augmented Variant Interpretation in Ovarian Cancer
text:
Lesson 2 — RNA fusion analysis
Gene fusions can be therapeutically relevant.
Examples in the source lesson include:

BCR-ABL
EML4-ALK

Fusion calling remains technically challenging because of:

unknown fusion partners
low gene expression
cryptic splice sites
difficult breakpoint mapping
poor-quality or low-cellularity specimens

title: AI-Augmented Variant Interpretation in Ovarian Cancer
text:
RNAfusion
RNAfusion is presented in the source lesson as an nf-core pipeline for RNA-seq fusion analysis.
Key characteristics:

standardized workflow
reproducible
portable
Nextflow-based
Docker / Singularity containerization
HPC and cloud integration
HTML reports
nf-core validation / linting

title: AI-Augmented Variant Interpretation in Ovarian Cancer
text:

nextflow run nf-core/rnafusion -profile test,docker
Why this matters clinically
Reproducibility is not only convenience.
It supports:

traceable software environments
consistent workflow execution
easier validation and re-analysis

title: Come aggiungere le 3 lezioni alla presentazione esistente
text:
Come aggiungere le 3 lezioni alla presentazione esistente
Non sostituire il tuo index.qmd.
Apri index.qmd e aggiungi in fondo il contenuto di:
append_lezioni.qmd
Oppure da terminale:
cat append_lezioni.qmd >> index.qmd
rm -rf docs
quarto render
xdg-open docs/index.html
Se il risultato è corretto:
git add .
git commit -m "Add decision framework RNAfusion and SplitFusion modules"
git push origin main
I tre moduli sono adattati allo stesso stile didattico della masterclass: - domanda/decisione - evidenza analitica - audit - errore da evitare - take-home
